paper.title: SWE-agent: Agent-Computer Interfaces Enable Automated Software Engineering
truncated_sections: B.5 Performance Variance and Pass@k Rate

result.summary: 本文提出 SWE-agent，一个由语言模型（LM）与 agent-computer interface（ACI）组成的系统，用于自主解决软件工程任务 [S1.p3]。作者认为 LM agent 是一类新的终端用户，需要专门设计的接口，并基于此设计了包含搜索/导航、文件查看、文件编辑和上下文管理等组件的 ACI [S2.p1][S3.p1]。在 SWE-bench 上，使用 GPT-4 Turbo 的 SWE-agent 解决了 12.47% 的 2,294 个测试任务，远超此前非交互式检索增强系统的 3.8% [S1.p4]；在 HumanEvalFix 上达到 88.3% 的 pass@1 [S5.p2]。作者通过消融实验表明，ACI 设计选择对 agent 性能有显著影响 [S1.p4][S5.SS1.p4]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：如何为语言模型 agent 设计专门的接口，以提升其完成软件工程任务的能力 [S1.p1][S2.p1]。作者指出，将 agent 应用于软件工程等更复杂代码任务仍未被探索，而人类工程师能从 VSCode 等强大应用中受益，因此受 HCI 研究启发，探究 LM agent 是否也能从更好设计的接口中受益 [S1.p1]。

evidence.quote: However, applying agents to more complex code tasks like software engineering remains unexplored.

Inspired by human-computer interaction (HCI) studies on the efficacy of user interfaces for humans, we investigate whether LM agents could similarly benefit from better-designed interfaces for performing software engineering tasks.
We argue that LM agents represent a new category of end user, with their own needs and abilities.

method.text: 论文提出 SWE-agent，由 LM 和 ACI 组成，通过迭代生成 thought 和 command 并接收环境反馈来与计算机交互 [S1.p3][S3.p1]。其 ACI 提供一小组简单动作用于查看、搜索和编辑文件，使用 guardrails 防止常见错误，并在每轮给出具体简洁的反馈 [S1.p3]。ACI 包含搜索/导航、文件查看器、文件编辑器和上下文管理等组件，并集成了代码 linter 以在编辑时提示错误 [S3.p1][S3.p5]。作者假设 LM 固定，专注于设计 ACI，通过人工检查 agent 行为和网格搜索来选择最佳配置 [S2.p4]。

evidence.quote: SWE-agent, an agent composed of an LM and ACI, that can interact with a computer to solve challenging real-world software engineering problems
SWE-agent’s ACI instead offers a small set of simple actions for viewing, searching through and editing files.
The ACI uses guardrails to prevent common mistakes, and an agent receives specific, concise feedback about a command’s effects at every turn.
The ACI comprises several principal components, including search/navigation, file viewer, file editor, and context management.
we integrate a code linter into the edit function to alert the agent of mistakes it may have introduced when editing a file.
we assume a fixed LM and focus on designing the ACI to improve its performance.
run a grid search to select the best ACI configuration.

experiments.text: 论文主要在 SWE-bench 数据集上评估，该数据集包含来自 12 个流行 Python 包的 2,294 个任务实例；消融和分析在 SWE-bench Lite（300 个实例）上进行 [S4.p1]。此外还用 HumanEvalFix 测试基本的代码编辑能力 [S4.p1]。对比设置包括 SWE-agent、Basic CLI 和 Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) [S4.T3]。作者还进行了超参数扫描，包括窗口大小、历史处理和解码温度 [S4.p6]。

evidence.quote: We primarily evaluate on the SWE-bench dataset, which includes $2,294$ task instances from $12$ different repositories of popular Python packages.
SWE-bench Lite is a canonical subset of $300$ instances from SWE-bench that focus on evaluating self-contained functional bug fixes.
We also test SWE-agent’s basic code editing abilities with HumanEvalFix, a short-form code debugging benchmark.
We benchmark models in the SWE-agent, Basic CLI, and Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) settings established in SWE-bench.
we performed a sweep over the window size, history processing, and decoding temperature

findings.text: 使用 GPT-4 Turbo 的 SWE-agent 解决了 12.47% 的 2,294 个 SWE-bench 测试任务，超过此前非交互式检索增强系统 3.8% 的最佳解决率 [S1.p4]。在 SWE-bench Lite 上，SWE-agent 比仅使用默认 Linux shell 的基线 agent 多解决 10.7 个百分点 [S1.p4]。SWE-agent 在 HumanEvalFix 上达到 88.3% 的 pass@1 [S5.p2]。消融实验表明，没有 SWE-agent 的文件编辑器接口时性能降至 10.3%（下降 7.7），文件查看器显示行数过少（30 行，下降 3.7）或过多（整个文件，下降 5.3）都会降低性能 [S5.SS1.p4]。

evidence.quote: SWE-agent solves $12.47$ % of the $2,294$ SWE-bench test tasks, substantially outperforming the previous best resolve rate of $3.8$ % by a non-interactive, retrieval-augmented system.
SWE-agent solves $10.7$ percentage points more instances than the baseline agent, which uses only the default Linux shell.
SWE-agent yields strong performance on HumanEvalFix with $88.3$ % pass@1 rate.
Without SWE-agent’s file editor interface, performance drops to ( $10.3$ % $\downarrow$ 7.7).
Either too little content (30 lines, $14.3$ % $\downarrow$ 3.7) or too much (entire file, $12.7$ % $\downarrow$ 5.3) lowers performance.
